description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pitipana North, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District (25/55048)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate properties and providing detailed land parcel information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, and land extents. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns property ownership, land registrations, and title settlement procedures under the Registration of Title Act.
